title: Theophilus Antecessor, Paraphrasis Institutionum / «Парафраз» Феофила

en_status: full (A. F. Murison, in Lokin, Meijering, Stolte & van der Wal, Theophili Antecessoris Paraphrasis Institutionum, Groningen: Chimaira 2010)
